page.overview:
Who is Al'iastov's former caregiver?

A Chiss female was the former caregiver of sky-walker navigator Al'iastov. At some point they told Al'iastov not to complain about her feelings. Around 39 BBY, on Al'iastov's final voyage as a sky-walker on the Chiss Defense Force Transport Tomra, she met Cadet Mitth'raw'nuru, core name "Thrawn," who saw her in a state of distress and asked if she was alright. Al'iastov, remembering her former caregiver, told the cadet she was fine.

This caregiver was mentioned in flashbacks of the 2020 novel Thrawn Ascendancy: Chaos Rising, written by Timothy Zahn as the first entry in his Star Wars: The Ascendancy Trilogy.
